create_RayNormalColoringNetwork: create a RayNormalColoringNetwork instance with default IDR mode and 512-unit hidden layers
forward_RayNormalColoringNetwork: forward feature vectors, points, normals, and a ray bundle through the coloring network
configure_harmonic_embedding: configure the network with harmonic embedding functions for view direction encoding
switch_rendering_mode: switch the network rendering mode between idr, no_view_dir, or no_normal
enable_weight_norm: enable or disable weight normalization on the network linear layers
